_comment: Why each rule exists. The rules themselves live in Dependency-Track; the gate prints the source next to every violation.
Known exploited or likely exploited: CRA Art. 13(5): due diligence for third-party components
No Log4Shell, Spring4Shell or Struts RCE: House rule: named vulnerabilities never ship
Critical vulnerabilities: CRA Art. 13(5): due diligence for third-party components
End of life (endoflife.date): CRA Art. 13(5): the component no longer receives security updates
Components older than four years: OWASP Top 10:2025 A03: choose versions deliberately
